evidence.observation: Growth setpoint held at 750 °C, readings 750.1-752.3 after a small 760 °C overshoot at stage entry
Ar stable at ~100 sccm matching setpoint throughout ramp and growth
O2 purged from 28763 ppm to 2-5 ppm and stable, no leak signature
Not installed; telemetry null, so tube pressure cannot be checked at all
Controller reports running with heater power varying plausibly (41-47%)

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure readings (gauge not installed); without them only the O2 trace constrains the atmosphere, so a pressure-only deviation (e.g. partial exhaust restriction) would be invisible. An independent leak/pressure check or a post-run film characterization would resolve it.
